english: a woman loves or hates; there is nothing in between

terms.latin: Aut amat aut ōdit mulier, nīl est tertium.
Aut amat aut ōdit mulier; nihil est tertium.
terms.comment: Traupman’s form of Publilius’s line, with nihil for nīl.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
Publilius Syrus, Sententiae A 6, checked against the Latin Library texts (CLTK mirror) (12 November 2026).
Publilius is cited as the loci collection numbers him, by position under each initial letter in the Latin Library text.
